acceptanceCovered: /sun-kudos renders a static banner, a 'Ghi nhận' trigger pill, and a vertical kudos feed with Load more pagination, publicly viewable with no auth guard on the page itself — confirmed via e2e/sun-kudos.spec.ts real GREEN and reviewer's fresh-server sanity check on port 3005
Empty state renders the exact copy 'Hiện tại chưa có Kudos nào.' when the feed has zero rows — confirmed byte-for-byte in kudos.json and asserted in kudos-board.test.tsx and e2e/sun-kudos.spec.ts

Unauthenticated click on the 'Ghi nhận' pill or a heart icon redirects to /login; authenticated click opens the composer modal or toggles a like — confirmed: requireAuth() in sun-kudos-client.tsx wraps both handlers, no bypass path found by reviewer

Composer modal: recipient search-as-you-type (required), plain textarea content (required), free-text hashtag chips min 1 / max 5 (required), 'Gửi' disabled until all three are filled, 'Hủy' discards and closes — confirmed via 10 passing component tests
On successful submit, the composer closes and the feed refetches page 1 to show the new kudos (not optimistic prepend, per clarifications.md) — confirmed in sun-kudos-client.tsx and its unit tests

Like/unlike: a user cannot like their own kudos (heart disabled), one like per user per kudos enforced by the kudos_likes composite primary key, sender_id/user_id always derived server-side from auth.uid(), never client-supplied — confirmed by reviewer: grepped for any client-supplied id param on createKudos/toggleLike, none found; self-like check ordering verified correct; composite PK confirmed as race-safe backstop

First DB schema for this project: profiles/kudos/kudos_likes tables + auth.users sync trigger + RLS (public read, own-row-only write) written in supabase/migrations/20260908165400_kudos_schema.sql, deliberately NOT applied to any live database in this session (no Supabase CLI available, user applies it themselves) — confirmed, this was an explicit user decision (AskUserQuestion), not a shortfall

findings.summary: listKudos originally failed soft on any Supabase error with zero logging, which would make a real bug indistinguishable from an empty feed once the migration is live. Fixed during delivery: orchestrator added console.error("listKudos failed", error) before the fail-soft return, re-verified against the real hosted Supabase project (PGRST205 now visibly logged) and re-ran jest/tsc clean.
createKudos does not reject receiverId === sender_id (sending a kudos to yourself is currently allowed). Not specified in the plan/clarifications; logged as a follow-up item, not a scope violation.

Rapid double-click on the like button can race two toggles into both reading 'not yet liked'; the second insert hits the kudos_likes PK violation and fails, and the UI swallows that failure with no error surfaced (cosmetic count inconsistency only, no data corruption since the PK holds). No data-integrity risk; logged as a UX follow-up.

Heart button's aria-pressed is hardcoded to false and never reflects the current user's actual like state (no visual 'already liked' indicator beyond the count changing). Confirmed cosmetic only — toggle is idempotent server-side, no double-count risk.
